create.sql: INSERT INTO habit_frequency_segments(id,habit_id,frequency,effective_on,created_on,version) SELECT ?,?,?,CASE WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM habit_frequency_segments WHERE habit_id=? AND effective_on<=?) THEN ? ELSE ? END,?,1 WHERE ?='set' AND COALESCE((SELECT frequency FROM habit_frequency_segments WHERE habit_id=? AND effective_on<=? ORDER BY effective_on DESC LIMIT 1),'')<>? ON CONFLICT(habit_id,effective_on) DO UPDATE SET frequency=excluded.frequency,created_on=excluded.created_on

update.sql: SELECT CASE WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM habit_frequency_segments WHERE habit_id=? AND created_on>?) THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS ok

DELETE FROM habit_frequency_segments WHERE habit_id=? AND effective_on>? AND (?='cancel_pending' OR (?='set' AND (SELECT frequency FROM habit_frequency_segments WHERE habit_id=? AND effective_on<=? ORDER BY effective_on DESC LIMIT 1)=?))

INSERT INTO habit_frequency_segments(id,habit_id,frequency,effective_on,created_on,version) SELECT ?,?,?,CASE WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM habit_frequency_segments WHERE habit_id=? AND effective_on<=?) THEN ? ELSE ? END,?,1 WHERE ?='set' AND COALESCE((SELECT frequency FROM habit_frequency_segments WHERE habit_id=? AND effective_on<=? ORDER BY effective_on DESC LIMIT 1),'')<>? ON CONFLICT(habit_id,effective_on) DO UPDATE SET frequency=excluded.frequency,created_on=excluded.created_on

archive.sql: UPDATE habits SET archived_at=COALESCE(archived_at,?) WHERE id=?

INSERT INTO habit_archive_pauses(id,habit_id,start_on,end_exclusive_on,reason,provenance) SELECT ?,?,?,NULL,'archive','recorded' WHERE NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM habit_archive_pauses WHERE habit_id=? AND end_exclusive_on IS NULL)

restore.sql: SELECT CASE WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM habit_archive_pauses WHERE habit_id=? AND start_on>?) THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS ok
UPDATE habits SET archived_at=NULL WHERE id=?
UPDATE habit_archive_pauses SET end_exclusive_on=? WHERE habit_id=? AND end_exclusive_on IS NULL
DELETE FROM habit_archive_pauses WHERE habit_id=? AND start_on=end_exclusive_on
